summary: Rocket One Inc. filed Amendment No. 3 to its prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 to increase the amount of common stock available for sale under its existing Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright Co. LLC. The amendment registers up to an additional $5,257,000 of common stock, following prior sales of 9,825,684 shares for gross proceeds of approximately $13.56 million. This is an ordinary shelf takedown under an ATM facility, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, tender, or restructuring event is involved. The offering is subject to General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3, limiting sales to one-third of public float in a 12-month period. No special-situation angle applies; this is routine capital raising.
